data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'azara', meaning to protect or guard. In Islamic tradition, Azra is a name given to girls, symbolizing the belief that God protects and cares for them. The name Azra carries the meaning “Protected by God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Azra usually hope their child will grow to embody protected by god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who is a protector, guardian, or caretaker in the spiritual realm
data.etymology: Azra belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protected by God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azra total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: عزرا
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عزرا مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ع-ز-ر' والذي يعني العون أو العزة. في بعض التفاسير، يرتبط بالعذراء أو الفتاة الجميلة. ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم كصفة للفتيات في الجنة.

in_urdu.name: عزرا
in_urdu.long_meaning: عزرا نام عربی جڑ 'ع-ز-ر' سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے مدد یا عزت۔ اردو میں، یہ نام خوبصورت لڑکی یا معصوم کے معنی میں استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ اسلامی تقالید میں اس کا تعلق جنتی لڑکیوں سے بھی جوڑا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अज़रा
in_hindi.long_meaning: अज़रा नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल 'ع-ز-ر' से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है मदद या सम्मान। हिंदी में, यह नाम सुंदर लड़की या कुंवारी के रूप में समझा जाता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम स्वर्ग की सुंदरियों से जुड़ा हुआ है।

in_pashto.name: عزرا
in_pashto.long_meaning: عزرا نوم د عربی جڑ 'ع-ز-ر' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې مرسته یا عزت ده. په پښتو کې، دا نوم د ښکلې نجلۍ یا بېګناه په معنا کارول کيږي. په اسلامي دود کې، دا نوم د جنت ښځو سره تړلی دی.

in_english.name: Azra
in_english.long_meaning: The name Azra originates from the Arabic root 'ع-ز-ر' (ʿ-z-r), meaning help, support, or power. In Islamic tradition, Azra is associated with the maidens of paradise. The name signifies beauty, purity, and spiritual significance. It is used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing virtues of kindness and compassion.
